# 1f: Navidrome and Telegram

## Read first

- [telegram.md](../telegram.md), [architecture.md](../architecture.md) sections Downloads and Events.
- The As built section of [1b](1b.md).
- vk2tg: `internal/tg/tg.go`, `internal/tg/queue.go`, `internal/bot/bot.go`. openswingsonic: `internal/endpoints/opensubsonicapi/models/` and `internal/middleware/opensubsonic_auth/auth.go`.

## Done when

- `internal/modules/navidrome` implements `source.Library`, runs `navidrome.scan` jobs, serves `/api/library/scan`, and reports health.
- `internal/modules/telegram` runs the bot from telegram.md and is the downloads module's notifier.
- Every checklist line has its test, against a fake Subsonic server and a fake Telegram client.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Subsonic auth | `u`; `t`, the MD5 of the password followed by the salt; `s`, a fresh random salt per request; `v=1.16.1`, `c=shelf`, `f=json`. Answers are unwrapped from `subsonic-response` and a `status` of `failed` becomes an error with its code and message. | Navidrome's API; no password in URLs. |
| Models | Copy the few models needed from openswingsonic and add `ScanStatus` with `scanning`, `count` and `lastScan`. | openswingsonic has no scan status model. |
| Scan job | Type `navidrome.scan` on the `library` queue, coalescing key `scan`. Each finished download enqueues it with `run_after` set to now plus `SHELF_NAVIDROME_SCAN_DELAY`; a merge moves `run_after` later. If `getScanStatus` says scanning, the job defers for 30 seconds. | One scan for a burst of downloads. |
| Scan events | The hub gets a `scan` event when a scan starts and when the next status poll sees it end. Polling runs every 10 seconds only while a scan is known to run. | The Downloads page shows the state. |
| Bot client | go-telegram/bot v1.27.0 behind a small `TG` interface that `*bot.Bot` satisfies, as in vk2tg. Options `WithWorkers(1)`, `WithNotAsyncHandlers()`, allowed updates `message` and `callback_query`. | Fakes in tests. |
| Proxy | `bot.WithHTTPClient` with a transport whose `Proxy` is `SHELF_PROXY_URL` when `SHELF_TELEGRAM_USE_PROXY` is on. | Per-module proxy choice. |
| Send queue | vk2tg's `queue.go`, adapted for edits. | Telegram's limits. |
| Progress edits | The module subscribes to `download` events and edits a status message at most every 5 seconds or on a state change. The final edit comes from the notifier call in the `notify` step. | telegram.md. |
| Search | Plain text calls every enabled `Searcher` with kind album and limit 5, in parallel with a 10-second limit. A source that fails is left out of the answer. | One slow source doesn't block the answer. |
| Confirmation | Artist and label links send the confirmation with the album count from `Resolver.Item`. Nothing is queued until Download all. | telegram.md. |
| Texts | All texts in `texts.go`. | One file to review. |

## Routes

| Route | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/library/scan` | `{"scanning", "count", "last_scan"}`, and as built the health fields `enabled`, `ok`, `message`, `address`, `latency_ms` |
| `POST /api/library/scan` | Enqueues a scan that runs now. |
| `GET /api/telegram` | As built: `{"enabled", "connected", "username", "users"}` |

## Checklist

| Edge case | Test |
| --- | --- |
| Requests carry `u`, `t`, `s`, `v`, `c`, `f`, never `p` | `TestSubsonicAuth` |
| A Subsonic error answer becomes an error with its code | `TestSubsonicError` |
| Three finished downloads in a burst give one scan | `TestScanCoalesces` |
| A scan already running defers the job | `TestScanDefers` |
| `POST /api/library/scan` starts a scan now | `TestScanNow` |
| A user outside the whitelist gets the refusal and nothing is queued | `TestUnknownUser` |
| A message with two links queues two downloads and sends two status messages | `TestLinksQueue` |
| A link no source knows, a disabled source, a music video | `TestLinkRefusals` |
| Progress edits come at most every 5 seconds, state changes at once | `TestEditThrottle` |
| The final edit happens once, also after a restart | `TestFinalEditOnce` |
| Cancel, Retry and Download again act on the download | `TestButtons` |
| A button from a user outside the whitelist does nothing | `TestButtonUnknownUser` |
| An artist link asks first and queues only on Download all | `TestArtistConfirmation` |
| Plain text answers with album buttons from each source | `TestTextSearch` |
| A failing source is left out of the search answer | `TestTextSearchSourceFails` |
| A tap on a search button queues the album | `TestSearchButtonQueues` |
| `/queue` lists running and queued downloads | `TestQueueCommand` |
| A 429 waits for `retry_after` | `TestRateLimit` |
| "Message is not modified" is ignored | `TestNotModifiedIgnored` |
| The proxy setting routes the bot's requests | `TestProxyOptIn` |

## As built

Finished on 2026-11-04. `make check`, `make lint`, `make web-check` and `docker build .` pass. A manual run of serve with the fake source and an unreachable Navidrome answered both new routes, finished a download that asked for a scan, and kept that scan as one waiting job. The bot was not run against Telegram, which needs a token; the manual checklist covers it in 1h.

What differs from the contract:

- Platform: `module.Runner` is the start hook that 1b's notes asked for. Only serve calls `Run`, and a `Run` that fails is logged while the server goes on. There is no `LibraryDeclarer`: `main` wires the `Scanner` port directly.
- Downloads: `downloads.New` creates the service, so `main` wires the bot and Navidrome before `Init`. The service gained `Ahead` and `DownloadedAt`. `OriginRef` gained `status_is_text`. 1b's notes expected a method that saves `status_message_id` after queuing. There is none. The bot sends the status message first and passes its ID in `origin_ref`, so the `notify` step can reach it even when a download ends at once.
- Source: `source.LinkRefuser` and `Registry.RefusedLink` let the bot refuse a music video without knowing the source. The fake source refuses `/video/` and `/station/` links.
- Scan job: `MaxAttempts` is 1. Navidrome that doesn't answer defers the job for a minute, up to ten times, so it stays the one scan that requests merge into; a Subsonic error fails it at once. The contract didn't say how a failed scan retries, and retries with backoff left one scan job per request.
- Scan routes: `GET /api/library/scan` reads Navidrome live and adds `enabled`, `ok`, `message`, `address` and `latency_ms`, which is the health the contract asks for and the Status page shows. `POST` answers 202 with `{"job_id"}`. A scan is followed by the module's `Run`, which polls only while a scan is known to run.
- Bot: `GET /api/telegram` is new, for the Status page. The confirmation's Open in Shelf goes to `/search?q=<link>`. A label asks "Download 34 albums from Example Label?". The send queue is vk2tg's, unchanged. The contract's "adapted for edits" lives in the editor, which keeps one edit per message in the queue and reads the state when the edit's turn comes. The last edit gives up after a minute, since the source's next download waits for the `notify` step. A second tap on Download all or Download again queues nothing more. The texts as built are in telegram.md.
- The quality in a caption's header comes from the lookup before the message was sent and lives in memory, so after a restart the header shows the source alone.
- Tests beyond the checklist: `TestScanEvents`, `TestScanStatusRoute`, `TestScansOff`, `TestScanRetries`, `TestScanGivesUp`, `TestLinksFound`, `TestCoverFallback`, `TestHelp`, `TestStatusRoute`, `TestNotConnected`, `TestStatusTexts`, `TestSizes`, `TestSendLimits`, `TestRunnersRunWithServe`, `TestManageStartsNoRunner`, `TestAhead`, `TestDownloadedAt`, and refusal cases in the registry and fake source tests. `TestEditThrottle` and the queue tests run in a `testing/synctest` bubble on a fake downloads port.

Notes for later steps:

- 1d and 1e: log in and start goroutines in `Run`, not `Init`.
- 1e: implement `source.LinkRefuser` for music videos and stations.
- 1g: the Status page reads `/api/telegram` and the health fields of `GET /api/library/scan`. The search page fills its field from `?q=` and resolves a link there, since the bot's confirmation links to it.
- 1h: run the Telegram line of the manual checklist with the real token and a phone.
